label: H.R. 10438
title: SYLLABLE Act of 2026

items.snippet: This bill authorizes the Department of Education to award up to five grants to partnerships of local educational agencies, early childhood education…

…technical assistance entities for the implementation of dual language immersion programs to serve low-income children, including English learners and minority children, in high-need schools from preschool through 5th grade.
…programs to serve low-income children, including English learners and minority children, in high-need schools from preschool through 5th grade.

lobbying.caption: From Senate lobbying disclosures (LD-2). A filing mentions this bill; it does not show what was asked for, which side the client took, or any contact with this member. Reported amounts cover the whole filing, not this bill alone.
lobbying.amount_note: Amounts are the income or expenses reported on the whole LD-2 filing, not money spent on this bill.

caption: This shows who the bill names and who lobbied on it. It does not show who gains or loses, and lobbying can be for or against a bill.

G000606.label: Overlap, not proof of influence.
G000606.caption: Money from this member's itemized individual donors (over $200) whose self-reported employer falls in an industry that also has a client lobbying on this bill. Correlation only; not a quid pro quo. Donors give to campaigns for many reasons, and a lobbying client may have opposed the bill.
